findings.label: API Key visibility on Vercel — likely risk
findings.description: Verify that GEMINI_API_KEY is added to Vercel Project Settings → Environment Variables before deployment. If omitted, API calls will fail silently or throw 500 errors because the backend will have an undefined key.

findings.label: vercel.json rewrite regex edge case — possible
findings.description: The current rewrite pattern /((?!api|_next|_static|.*\..*|$).*) is Vercel-specific regex and may need adjustment if you add new API prefixes or change the project structure. The pattern explicitly excludes /api/*, /static/*, and files with extensions, which is correct for Vite + SPA. If issues arise, this is where to look first.
